# langsmith_repo_owners (Data Source)

Lists the collaborators ("owners") of a LangSmith prompt repo.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the owners (collaborators) of a prompt repo in the current workspace.
data "langsmith_repo_owners" "example" {
  repo_handle = "my-prompt"
}

output "owner_emails" {
  value = [for o in data.langsmith_repo_owners.example.owners : o.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_handle` (String) The name of the prompt repo whose owners should be listed.

### Optional

- `owner` (String) The owner handle of the repo. Defaults to `-`, the wildcard for the current workspace, matching how `langsmith_prompt` addresses repos.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier of the form `<owner>/<repo_handle>`.
- `owners` (Attributes List) The collaborators of the repo. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp at which the owner was added to the repo.
- `email` (String) Email address of the owner.
- `full_name` (String) Full name of the owner.
- `identity_id` (String) Identity UUID of the owner.
- `ls_user_id` (String) LangSmith user ID of the owner.
